tagline: A quiet practice in the heart of the city.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Come as you are. Move as you must.
sections.subheadline: A Brooklyn studio for thoughtful movement, breath, and rest — in person and online.

sections.name: class_types
sections.description: Three card-style introductions to signature class formats: Slow Flow Vinyasa, Yin & Restore, and Pranayama + Meditation, each with a one-line invitation and duration.

sections.name: weekly_preview
sections.description: Preview of three upcoming sessions this week, e.g., 'Tue 7:00am — Morning Flow with Amara Okafor', 'Wed 6:30pm — Candlelit Yin with Ines Marchetti', 'Sat 9:00am — Breathwork Circle with Devan Rao'.

sections.name: teacher_spotlight
sections.description: Soft portrait and short feature on a rotating teacher, e.g., 'This month: Amara Okafor on returning to the breath.'

sections.name: membership_invitation
sections.description: Gentle three-tier overview: Studio Unlimited ($189/mo), 8-Class Pack ($168), and Stillwater Stream online ($24/mo).

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Studio address (147 Wythe Ave, Brooklyn), hours, newsletter signup labeled 'Receive our seasonal letter', and Instagram/Spotify links.

sections.name: filters
sections.description: Filter row with class type (Vinyasa, Yin, Meditation, Prenatal), teacher dropdown, level toggle (Beginner / All Levels / Advanced), and a 'Virtual classes' switch.

sections.name: weekly_calendar
sections.description: Seven-column calendar grid Mon–Sun listing class cards with time, name, teacher in italic, duration, level, spots remaining, and a soft 'Reserve' button — examples: 'Mon 6:30am Slow Flow · Amara · 60min · 4 spots', 'Thu 12:15pm Lunch Yin · Ines · 45min · Online'.

sections.name: cancellation_note
sections.description: Quiet paragraph explaining the 12-hour cancellation window and how late cancels affect class packs.

sections.name: intro
sections.headline: The hands that hold the practice.
sections.subheadline: Twelve teachers, one shared commitment to slow, honest movement.

sections.name: teacher_grid
sections.description: Directory of teacher cards with soft photography, each showing name, lineage/certifications (e.g., E-RYT 500, Iyengar Level 2), specialty, years practicing, and a two-line bio — sample names: Amara Okafor, Ines Marchetti, Devan Rao, Yuki Tanabe.

sections.name: teacher_detail_preview
sections.description: Expanded view for one featured teacher with upcoming classes list and Instagram handle (@amara.breathes).

sections.name: intro
sections.headline: Deeper time, fuller practice.
sections.subheadline: Seasonal workshops in the studio and small-group retreats abroad.

sections.name: upcoming_events
sections.description: List of three event cards, e.g., 'Winter Yin & Yoga Nidra Immersion — Ines Marchetti — Feb 17, in-studio — Investment: $145', 'Breath & Backbends Workshop — Devan Rao — Mar 9, online — Investment: $65', 'Costa Rica Retreat — Nosara — May 4–11 — Investment: $2,890'.

sections.name: registration
sections.description: Quiet inline registration form with name, email, dietary notes, and a 'limited to 14 practitioners' spots counter.

sections.name: founding_story
sections.description: Short narrative of founder Mira Halvorsen opening Stillwater in 2018 after a decade of teaching in Kyoto and New York.

sections.name: philosophy
sections.description: Three-pillar values block: Slowness, Lineage, Belonging — each with a one-line statement.

sections.name: the_space
sections.description: Photo gallery and brief description of the 1,800 sq ft studio with reclaimed oak floors, linen curtains, and a tea bar.

sections.name: testimonials
sections.description: Three student quotes with first name and years practicing, e.g., 'Stillwater gave me back my mornings. — Priya, 3 years'.

sections.name: community_giving
sections.description: Note about the weekly Sunday Karma Class donating proceeds to The Loveland Foundation.

sections.name: faq
sections.description: Six short questions for new students covering what to bring, arrival time, class etiquette, and pricing.

sections.description: Logo strip of mentions in Well+Good, Goop, and The Cut.
